text_block_list.text:
T.M. Opera O missed 1st place
by the narrowest of margins...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
If only you'd been a little sooner!
You could've seen me glistening with competitive sweat!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
However, I can't help it!
The wind blows because it misses my refreshing self, you see.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Making that face like me whenever I'm startled by
the radiant Umamusume reflected in the mirror.
choice_data_list: Seeing you as your usual self puts me at ease!
I was sure you were feeling down...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, whatever could you be on about?
I'm as beautiful as ever, more so than anyone else.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Come, Trainer! Let us return to the academy,
and polish my brilliance even further!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me! Next time, it won't be dripping water that shines.
It will be my valiant run...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
...The light is always in the heavens.
Its brilliance may dazzle you, causing you to cast your eyes downward at times.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
If I cast my eyes down, it would cast a shadow.
Upon the audience to whom I must show my glory.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
That is unacceptable!
If so, what kind of figure should I present to the world?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Watch me, everyone!
Witness the future me who will shine brighter than even I do now...!

Never satisfied with just placing, she always aimed for higher ground...
Her figure was truly more radiant than anyone else's!
